app.title: Bulkut — local video editing
app.name: Bulkut
app.footer: Runs entirely in your browser with ffmpeg.wasm. Your files never leave this device.

engine.hint: The video engine (ffmpeg.wasm) loads on the first render.

suffix.label: Output suffix
suffix.hint: Appended to the file name before download.

common.oneAtATime: One video at a time, in launch order.

settings.title: Global settings
settings.hint: These values apply to every video that follows the defaults.

fields.thresholdHint: Loudness below this level is treated as silence.
fields.precutHint: Extra time kept just before speech starts.
fields.postcutHint: Breathing room kept just after speech ends.
fields.minClipHint: Kept clips shorter than this duration are dropped.

list.title: Videos
list.hint: Each video can override the global settings.

autocut.empty: No videos yet. Drop a few clips to remove their silences.

autoEstimate.title: Auto-estimate durations
autoEstimate.hint: After a settings change, estimate each output duration without rendering. Values are computed 3 seconds after the last change.

estimate.label: duration estimate
estimate.hint: Estimated from the silence analysis, before any rendering.

modal.title: Settings for “{name}”
modal.hint: Starts from the current values; applies to this video only.

excerpt.title: Render a 1-minute preview from the middle of the video

badge.custom: Uses settings specific to this video.

output.title: Output format
output.hint: Timelines reuse the source file and can be relinked in the editor.

params.title: Threshold · pre-cut · post-cut · minimum clip duration

settings.title: Cut settings
settings.hint: Pick the start and end of the clip, then export.

list.title: Clip
list.hint: One file at a time; the sliders set the kept range.

settings.title: Reverse settings
settings.hint: Plays the clip and its audio backwards.

reverse.warning: Reversing buffers the whole clip in memory: keep it short (a few minutes).
reverse.longWarning: This clip is {duration} long: reversing buffers all of it in memory and may fail.

settings.title: Collage settings
settings.hint: Clips are joined end to end, in the order below.

list.title: Clips
list.hint: Drag a row, or use the arrows, to change the order.

collage.empty: No clips yet. Add videos to build a collage.
collage.note: The clips are re-encoded together: one video at a time, in list order.
collage.label: collage

settings.title: Intro / Outro settings
settings.hint: Every video is exported on its own, with the intro, the outro, or both.

introoutro.empty: No videos yet. Add clips, then give them an intro and an outro.
introoutro.needEdge: Add an intro or an outro to enable rendering.

presets.saveHint: Name this preset. It will only be available in this tab.
presets.loadHint: Load a preset to replace the current settings, or delete the ones you no longer need.
presets.empty: No presets saved for this tab yet.

errors.numberRange: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.notVideo: {name} is not a supported video file.
errors.busy: A video is already being processed.
errors.startBeforeEnd: The start must stay before the end (at least 1 second).
errors.endAfterStart: The end must stay after the start (at least 1 second).
errors.timecode: Enter a valid timecode between 00:00:00 and 99:59:59.
errors.duration: Could not read the video duration.
errors.noAudio: This video has no audio track to analyse.
errors.noSegments: No speech found with these settings. Try another threshold.
errors.tooManySegments: Too many segments to render ({max} max). Raise the threshold or the minimum silence.
errors.noVideoStream: No video stream found in this file.
errors.renderFailed: FFmpeg could not render this video.
errors.ffmpegUnavailable: The ffmpeg.wasm runtime is missing. Check the vendor/ffmpeg folder.
errors.opfsUnavailable: This browser does not support OPFS storage. Use index.html instead.
errors.opfsMount: Could not mount {name} in the video engine.
errors.presetNameTaken: A preset named “{name}” already exists in this tab.
errors.presetStorage: Could not save the preset: cookies are unavailable or full.
errors.presetTooLarge: Too many presets saved: delete some to free up space.

pro.badgeHint: Pro page: files are stored in the browser with OPFS.
pro.title: Bulkut Pro — local video editing with OPFS
pro.description: Bulkut Pro — cut silences, trim clips and reverse videos locally with OPFS storage and ffmpeg.wasm.
pro.note: OPFS mode: videos are streamed from browser storage and mounted read-only in FFmpeg, so the import size limit does not apply. They stay on this device.
pro.storageNote: Stored locally in your browser with OPFS — no import size limit.

desktop.engineHint: FFmpeg is looked up in the ffmpeg folder next to the application.
desktop.storageNote: Files are read directly from disk — no import limit.
desktop.footer: Native desktop edition. Everything runs locally with FFmpeg — no upload, no size limit.

fade.title: Fades
fade.hint: Applied once to each finished file, never inside the clips.
fade.durationHint: 0.1 to 1 second. One second by default.

settings.title: Split settings
settings.hint: Cut one video into as many ranges as you need.

list.title: Segments
list.hint: Set a start and an end for every segment.

splitter.note: Each segment is rendered as its own file. Allow multiple downloads in your browser when asked.

download.title: Bulkut for desktop
download.lead: The full Bulkut toolset, natively. One file, no install, no browser and no import size limit.
download.note: Each build bundles FFmpeg. The application extracts it next to the executable on first launch.
download.requirements: Requires Windows 10/11, a recent Linux distribution, macOS 12+ or Android 7+.
download.webLead: Run Bulkut right now in your browser, or use the Pro page for large files.

mobile.storageNote: Picked files are copied into the app's private storage.
